{{Quote|You, Trevik of the Midli of the Seventh of the Red, have betrayed me.|The Queen of the Red to bowlcarrier Trevik|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
The '''Midli of the Seventh of the Red''' was a subcaste of the [[Quesoth]] [[Midli]] caste based in the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]'s [[Red City]], which the [[Queen of the Red]] ruled, which oversaw the Quesoth [[Workers (Quesoth)|Workers]]. The Midli of the Seventh included the [[Trevik's family|family]] of the Quesoth [[Trevik]], whose brother was [[Jirvin]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> Trevik, who during that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] became the [[bowlcarrier]] of the [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|reigning]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of the Red, carrying a bowl of [[Nectar/Legends|nectar]] for her, betrayed his monarch by recording the artwork brought to the [[City/Legends|City's]] [[Dwelling of Guests]] building by [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], was informed by the monarch that she knew of his treason during a [[Attack on the Red City|battle]] between her and Esva's forces and the [[Empire of the Hand]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Midli of the Seventh of the Red appeared in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published within the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of his [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
